description: A TIP120 switches a 50 ohm load on 5 V with 1 kilohm in the base: fully on.
derivation: The base takes (5 - 1.3) / 1000 = 3.7 mA, so the minimum gain of 1000 allows 3.7 A. The load needs only (5 - 0.9) / 50 = 82 mA, so the Darlington saturates and the collector sits at the saturation voltage of 0.9 V.
